title: German Fish Fry
description: A classic German dish featuring crispy fried fish, served with a side of stir-fried vegetables.
instructions: Heat 1/2 cup of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Dredge the fish fillets in the flour, shaking off excess.
Dip the floured fish fillets in the beaten eggs, making sure they are fully coated.
Roll the egg-coated fish fillets in the crushed Peruvian corn flakes to coat.
Place the coated fish fillets in the hot oil and fry for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until golden brown and cooked through.
Remove the fried fish from the oil with a slotted spoon and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
In the same skillet, heat 1/4 cup of vegetable oil over medium heat.
Add the stir-fry vegetables to the skillet and cook until tender-crisp, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the crispy bacon bits, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Serve the fried fish with the stir-fry vegetables and crispy bacon bits.
Garnish with additional Peruvian corn flakes if desired.
